Notes

Part of the Chain Set. Obtainable in the Bear Room Quest, in Rookgaard. This can also be obtained via unrusting a Heavily Rusted Armor and Rusted Armor.

It is the best armor in Rookgaard, although some people still prefer to use the Studded Armor because it is lighter.
